surface_treatment.borders: 1px solid var(--border). Never use heavy drop shadows on cards. Embrace flat, geometric containers.
surface_treatment.border_radius: rounded-none (0px) for all primary containers, buttons, and inputs. Extreme sharpness to mimic print layouts.
surface_treatment.texture: Global noise overlay. Add a fixed full-screen div with pointer-events-none and a base64 SVG noise pattern at 3-4% opacity over the background.
surface_treatment.transparency: No blurry glassmorphism. Use solid backgrounds or transparent containers with 1px borders. Never use transparent background in headers/dropdowns with content underneath.

match_score_ring.ring: SVG circle with stroke-width 2-4. Background track: rgba(255,255,255,0.1). Fill track: currentColor (accent lime).

landing.layout: Asymmetric hero section. Left side: Massive H1 typography, mono micro-labels, and a primary CTA. Right side: Bleeding-edge abstract architectural image (black/white or muted) masking into the background. Followed by a strict 3-column bento grid for 'How it Works'.
landing.nav: Top nav, solid off-white background, hairline bottom border. Logo left (serif), links center (mono), Google Auth right (primary button).

how_it_works.layout: Editorial reading page. Left column (sticky): Monospace index (01. Profile, 02. Search, 03. Auto-Submit). Right column: Deep dive text with large serif headers, generous max-w-prose reading width, and inline geometric diagrams or images.

dashboard.shell: Logged-in shell: 250px left sidebar (bg-sidebar, fg-sidebar_fg). Main content area takes remaining width (bg-background).
dashboard.sidebar: Logo in Serif. Navigation links in monospace, active state gets an electric lime left border (border-l-2) and text color change.
dashboard.content: Welcome message (H2 serif). Bento grid of stats (Profile Completeness in large mono text). Quick Action sharp buttons. 'Recommended Matches' section with horizontal scrolling or 2-col grid cards containing the Match Score Ring.

job_search.layout: Header section with heavy 1px border bottom containing search inputs and location. 'Job Sources' selector (Greenhouse/Lever/JSearch) styled as monospace toggle tabs.
job_search.cards: List view of jobs. Each row/card is a flat box with bottom border. Left side: Job Title (Serif, large), Company (sans). Right side: Match Score Ring, Strengths/Gaps summary (mono labels), and a solid primary CTA 'Analyze Match' opening a Dialog.

applications.layout: Page header: 'My Applications' (Serif). Status sub-tabs below (All/Pending/Applied/Rejected) using the sharp tab component rules.
applications.list: Data table or list format. Strict 1px borders between rows. Actions: 'Approve' (Ghost/Secondary), 'Auto-Submit' (Primary lime).
applications.modal: View & Copy Modal: 2-column split. Left: Original Resume content. Right: AI Cover Letter. Content wrapped in stylized <pre> or monospace blocks to preserve formatting. High contrast 'Copy' buttons.

interview_prep.layout: Single column, max-w-3xl centralized for reading, but aligned left. Markdown content rendered with large serif headers, sans body, blockquotes with left thick ink border. Tone: Career coach.

profile.layout: 2-column split. Left: Form fields stacked with hairline borders (Skills, Experience, Location, Industries). Right: 'Resume Upload' dropzone - large square, dashed 1px border, monospace instructions centered.

motion_accessibility.motion: No bouncy/spring animations. Keep transitions fast, linear, or ease-out (150ms-200ms) for opacity and colors. Hover states should feel instantly responsive.
motion_accessibility.accessibility: Maintain strict contrast. The electric lime (#D4FF00) must only be used with dark ink (#060A14) text on top for APCA/WCAG compliance. Focus rings must be square, 1px solid ink color. All interactive elements must support keyboard navigation.

instructions_to_main_agent.tech_stack: React (.js files, NOT .tsx), Tailwind CSS, Shadcn UI primitives, lucide-react for icons.
instructions_to_main_agent.setup: Inject the provided Google Fonts import into index.css. Apply global CSS variables for colors. Apply the noise overlay class to the root layout.
instructions_to_main_agent.shadcn_customization: Radically strip Shadcn defaults. Remove rounded-md or rounded-lg from ALL components (cards, dialogs, buttons, inputs). Set border-radius to 0. Remove standard drop shadows. Replace with hairline borders. Ensure all Dropdowns/Popovers have solid backgrounds.
instructions_to_main_agent.testing: CRITICAL: Do NOT alter, remove, or change any existing `data-testid` attributes. If creating new interactive elements, add kebab-case `data-testid` properties.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs (AI slop). AVOID generic purple/indigo gradients, heavy shadows, and floating centered floating cards. Stick strictly to the editorial, flat, geometric aesthetic defined here.
No Inter, Roboto, or Open Sans. Use Cormorant Garamond for headings, Manrope for body, Space Mono for labels/metrics.
Never center align paragraph text or structural layouts unless explicitly a small modal. Left-align text for human natural reading flow.
Use 2-3x more padding/spacing inside sections. Use p-8 to p-12 in containers.
Do NOT use HTML native date pickers or selects. Use Shadcn components, stripped of their Vercel-like rounded aesthetics.
Ensure the match-score gauge uses the high-contrast lime and dark ink setup, preserving legibility.
Execute layout with React JS. Ensure 'use client' directives are maintained where necessary if running Next (but this is React+FastAPI, so standard Vite/CRA React applies).
